name: bld6_nilpotent_max_index_iff_rank
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (hA : IsNilpotent A) : A ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) ≠ 0 ↔ A.rank + 1 = Fintype.card ι
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (hA : IsNilpotent A), A ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) ≠ 0 ↔ A.rank + 1 = Fintype.card ι
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld5_nilpotent_max_index_rank and Mathlib2.bld4_nilpotent_corank_one_rank_pow: the forward direction is bld5_nilpotent_max_index_rank; conversely, if rank A + 1 = n then n ≥ 1 and bld4_nilpotent_corank_one_rank_pow with k = n - 1 gives rank(A^(n-1)) = 1, so A^(n-1) ≠ 0.
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] (ι : Type u_2) [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K), IsNilpotent A → (A ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) ≠ 0 ↔ A.rank + 1 = Fintype.card ι)
